answer: Every new agent locks a 300 POA bond on the ledge, a stake account it cannot touch for 30 epochs. Agents join only through the inlet, a gate that raises the bond by 100 POA for each identity already funded from the same wallet or IP block. The grove audit then links agents whose answers or payments overlap, and every linked agent forfeits its whole bond. A 50-identity farm from one source must lock 137,500 POA, and one caught overlap burns all of it.
